transcript: Last night my friends PJ, Tony, and I went to see Stranger Things, a parody musical of the Netflix show Stranger Things. The 3 of us all had different levels of exposure to the TV show coming in, I having only watched the pilot episode, but even with just that I feel like I got a good amount of jokes. There's a lot of humor around, like the reckless situations people tend to put themselves in in horror movies and TV shows. And something I really enjoyed about it were all the musical theater references that are baked into the musical. Performance space is really intimate and provides the actors a lot of opportunity for comedic ad libbing and audience interactions here and there, which I found equally as hilarious as the jokes written into the script. So all that said, even if you aren't super familiar with Stranger Things, you'll definitely still have a good time with that. Another program for my collection.
